segments.text: LOrde, howe are they encreaſed that trouble me? many are they that ryſe agaynſt me.
Many one there bee that ſaye of my ſoule: there is no helpe for him in his God.
But thou, O Lorde, art my defender: thou art my worſhyp, and the lifter vp of my head.
I dyd call vpon the Lorde with my voyce: and he hearde me out of his holy hill.
I layde me downe and ſlept: and roſe vp agayne, for the Lorde ſuſtayned me.
I wil not be afrayd for ten thouſādes of the people: that haue ſet themſelues agaynſte me rounde aboute.
Vp Lorde and helpe me, O my God: for thou ſmiteſt all myne enemies vpon the cheke bone, thou haſte broken the teeth of the vngodly.
Saluacion belongeth vnto the lorde: and thy bleſſing is vpon thy people.
Glory bee to the father and to the ſonne: and to the holy ghoſt.
As it was in the beginning, is nowe, and euer ſhalbee: worlde without ende. Amen.
